theme_and_archetype.rationale: Education and AI tutors require trust, clarity, and authority. The Swiss & High-Contrast archetype (using stark white bases and a singular sharp accent) establishes a structured 'learning blueprint' aesthetic, avoiding the cliché 'fintech-bro dark mode' while remaining thoroughly modern.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing + 'Control Room' grids for dashboard clarity.

landing_page.grid: Tetris grid. A mix of col-span-12, col-span-8, and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.
landing_page.spacing: p-12 to p-24 for main sections.

dashboard.grid: Control Room grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gap-4.
dashboard.surface_style: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style with 1px solid border-border/40.

spacing_and_layout.corners: rounded-none or max rounded-sm. Keep edges sharp to reflect precision.

components_strategy.buttons: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary buttons use accent_primary (#002FA7) with white text. Hover state must explicitly define text-white.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or flat cards with 1px border. No soft shadows. For hover states: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and a sharp solid shadow (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #09090B).
components_strategy.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn components heavily customized to be sharp and brutalist. Focus states must have a 2px ring of accent_primary.
components_strategy.ai_chat: Tutor chat should feel like a terminal or clean notebook. Use alternating subtle backgrounds (white vs #F4F4F5) instead of standard chat bubbles.
components_strategy.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers. bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px bottom border border-border/40.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Button hover darkens background and ensures contrast.
motion_and_interaction.loading_states: Since AI generation is multi-step, use an 'ASCII Art' or 'Terminal' style loader to fit the high-contrast/tech vibe.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, providing a technical yet accessible look.

data_testid_guidelines.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

hero_background.description: Dark blue abstract background with grid lines. Use as a subtle, low-opacity overlay for the landing page hero section.

study_mood.description: Focused teenager studying. Use in the 'About' or 'Why use this app' section to humanize the AI product.

concept_placeholder.description: Modern abstract 3D render with blue geometric shapes. Use as the default placeholder image for newly generated concepts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
Do NOT use standard Vercel/Shadcn rounded corners. Override all generic border-radius to rounded-none or rounded-sm.
For the roadmap node visualization, avoid standard bullet points. Use D3.js, react-flow, or a custom SVG implementation to make it look like a technical blueprint or subway map.
Ensure all Shadcn components (Dialogs, Select, Inputs) are modified to match the brutalist, high-contrast aesthetic.
Strictly follow the data-testid rules for all buttons, inputs, and major containers.
